title: Squid Protocol* — Signature Replay Attack Analysis (3 Consecutive Incidents)
root_cause: Signature Replay Attack — nonce `0xf9a0d115` not invalidated after use
steps: 1. **Obtaining a valid signature bundle**: A withdrawal signature bundle created by 3 authorized signers was leaked
2. **Nonce selection**: `0xf9a0d115` (= 2102-09-18 timestamp) — a practically permanent nonce that never expires
3. **Prior knowledge** that the signature bundle could be replayed regardless of pool ID
→ Router forwards withdrawal request to Pool
